t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each pair of gnomes always appear together but sometimes in different positions. Each gnome from a pair leads to a different forrest, bright or dark. I need to find the forest with the most mushrooms each time but this will constantly change so I must learn which gnome leads to the most bountiful forest.

vb_textbox.text: I seemed to be collecting more mushrooms more of the time in the darker forests so I tended to select one of the gnomes from each pair that led to those. There were exceptions to this when the brighter forest had more mushrooms but I mainly stuck to the advise that I had been given!
